content.title: Police Transparency
content.summary: The Arvada Police Department prioritizes transparency and accountability to foster trust within the community, providing a centralized resource for information on operations, policies, and public reporting. Key resources include the 2025 Annual Report detailing crime trends and departmental achievements, technology used for public safety, and an Internal Affairs Summary addressing misconduct allegations. The Department also emphasizes ongoing training and community engagement to enhance professionalism and effective policing.
content.body:
The Arvada Police Department is committed to transparency, accountability, and building trust through open communication with the community we serve. Transparency is an important part of modern policing and helps residents better understand how the Department operates, how decisions are made, and how officers serve the community every day.

This webpage serves as a central resource for information related to Department operations, policies, technology, accountability, and public reporting. Through these resources, the Department aims to provide meaningful insight into policing in Arvada while supporting informed community conversations about public safety.

The information below includes annual reports, demographic information, training initiatives, technology transparency, accountability reporting, and other data related to Department operations and community engagement.

## 2025 Annual Report

The [Arvada Police Department’s 2025 Annual Report (PDF)](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/7240/2025-Arvada-Police-Department-Annual-Report-?bidId=) provides an overview of crime trends, staffing, community engagement, special programs, investigations, traffic enforcement, and other Department accomplishments from the past year.

## Transparency Resource Pages

### Police Technology

Learn about the technology systems used by the Department to improve public safety, officer safety, investigations, and operational efficiency. This section includes information about:

- The Arvada Real Time Information Center
- Drone as First Responder
- Automated License Plate Readers
- Facial Recognition Technology
- Draft One report writing software
- Body-Worn Cameras

This section also includes Department policies, transparency reports and portals, FAQs, and information about safeguards, privacy protections, and legal compliance related to Department technology. Visit our [Police Technology page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1530/Police-Technology).

### 2025 Internal Affairs Summary

The Department investigates all allegations of misconduct thoroughly and objectively. The Internal Affairs Summary provides information regarding citizen complaints, internal investigations, policy violations, and disciplinary outcomes while protecting legally confidential personnel information. This reporting reflects the Department’s commitment to accountability, professionalism, and public trust. Visit our [2025 Internal Affairs Summary page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/544/2025-Internal-Affairs-Summary).

### Police Uniforms

Arvada police officers wear clearly visible identifiers on their uniforms in compliance with Colorado law and Department policy. This section explains officer identification requirements, including nameplates, badge numbers, and other identifying information worn by sworn personnel. Visit our [Police Uniforms page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1482/Police-Uniforms).

### Crime Maps & Statistics

Access crime maps, public crime statistics, and data dashboards that provide insight into crime trends and calls for service throughout the community.

Information may include:

- Reported crime trends
- Calls for service
- Traffic safety data
- Neighborhood crime mapping tools
- Annual statistical reports

Visit our [Crime Maps & Statistics page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/538/Crime-Maps-Statistics)

### Training & Development

The Department places a strong emphasis on training as a cornerstone of professionalism, accountability, public trust, and effective community policing. Through comprehensive and ongoing instruction, the Department ensures officers and professional staff are prepared to serve the community safely, ethically, and professionally in a rapidly evolving public safety environment.

Visit our [Training & Development page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/541/Training-and-Development).

### Community & Police Demographics

The Department regularly reviews workforce demographics and recruitment efforts to help ensure hiring practices reflect equal opportunity principles and the diversity of the available workforce. This section includes demographic comparisons, Equal Employment Opportunity information, and recruiting initiatives.

Visit our [Community & Police Demographics page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/543/Community-Police-Demographics).

### Traffic Warnings & Citation Data

In accordance with Colorado transparency laws, the Department tracks and publishes information related to traffic stops, warnings, and citations. This data supports accountability and allows for ongoing review of enforcement activity and trends.

Visit our [Traffic Warnings & Citation Data page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/547/Traffic-Warnings-Citations-Data).

## Questions or Feedback

The Arvada Police Department welcomes questions, feedback, and community engagement regarding Department operations and transparency initiatives.

Residents can:

- Complete a [community survey](https://secure.cuehit.net/take-survey/public/76389)
- Submit questions or feedback through [Ask Arvada](https://www.arvadaco.gov/898/Report-a-Problem-or-Ask-a-Question)
- [Contact the Police Department](https://www.arvadaco.gov/203/Contact-the-Arvada-Police-Department) directly
- Participate in [community programs and events](https://www.arvadaco.gov/849/Events-and-Programs)

Together, transparency and open communication help strengthen trust and improve public safety for everyone in the Arvada community.
